verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform, so choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions data regions, residency options, or storage location controls. The docs cover account opening, KYC, payments, cards, sandbox testing and webhooks, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
